496: /// Whether a node is **effectively `FILL`-sized on an axis** (LAYOUT.md §fill
497: /// propagation, SwiftUI/Compose parity): it is `FILL` itself, a layout-greedy
498: /// primitive that fills the axis by nature, or a Hug-sized container whose
499: /// subtree carries such a child. A Fixed box bounds its subtree.
500: ///
501: /// `axis_horizontal` selects `WIDTH` (true) or `HEIGHT`; `main_axis` tells
502: /// whether the axis is the node's parent's main axis (governs `SPACER`/`DIVIDER`
503: /// greediness).
504: fn fills_axis(
505:     nodes: &BTreeMap<u32, Node>,
506:     id: u32,
507:     axis_horizontal: bool,
508:     main_axis: bool,
509: ) -> bool {
510:     let Some(node) = nodes.get(&id) else {
511:         return false;
512:     };
513:     let prop = if axis_horizontal {
514:         property_id::WIDTH
515:     } else {
516:         property_id::HEIGHT
517:     };
518:     let hint = node.properties.get(&prop).map(|b| f32::from_bits(*b));
519:     match hint {
520:         Some(v) if v == size::FILL => return true,
521:         Some(v) if v.is_finite() && v > 0.0 => return false, // Fixed bounds
522:         _ => {}
523:     }
524:     let greedy = match node.component {
525:         component_type::COLOR | component_type::SCROLLVIEW => true,
526:         component_type::SPACER => main_axis,
527:         component_type::DIVIDER => !main_axis,
528:         _ => false,
529:     };
530:     if greedy {
531:         return true;
532:     }
533:     if !matches!(
534:         node.component,
535:         component_type::VSTACK
536:             | component_type::HSTACK
537:             | component_type::ZSTACK
538:             | component_type::LAZY_VSTACK
539:             | component_type::LAZY_HSTACK
540:     ) {
541:         return false;
542:     }
543:     // A child's greedy nature is relative to its own parent (this node).
544:     let child_main = stack_main_horizontal(node.component)
545:         .map(|main_h| main_h == axis_horizontal)
546:         .unwrap_or(false); // ZSTACK has no main axis
547:     node.children
548:         .iter()
549:         .any(|&child| fills_axis(nodes, child, axis_horizontal, child_main))
550: }

647: fn days_to_date(days: i32) -> (i32, u32, u32) {
648:     let z = i64::from(days) + 719_468;
649:     let era = if z >= 0 { z } else { z - 146_096 } / 146_097;
650:     let doe = z - era * 146_097;

657:     let y = if m <= 2 { y + 1 } else { y };

659: }
